We also offer mental health support services utilizing a variety of therapeutic techniques that are tailored to meet the unique needs of each client.

centre.about_html:
At Muskoka Recovery program, our aim is to offer a holistic approach to supporting clients through addiction recovery, relapse prevention, and optimal mental health. Our approach is centered around the needs of each individual client, with a range of individual counseling and group therapy services on offer. Our group therapy is designed to provide support through psychoeducation, skills and interventions, and a sense of communal belonging and fellowship. We also offer mental health support services utilizing a variety of therapeutic techniques that are tailored to meet the unique needs of each client.

Muskoka Recovery - Center Overview

Muskoka Recovery is a rehabilitation center located in the serene forested suburbs outside Toronto. It provides a range of services that includes detoxification, as well as residential care in two locations- King City and Muskoka. The center offers personalized and holistic care for mental health treatment, relapse prevention plans, and therapeutic sessions.

The centre has a set of core values that its team embodies to help clients recover, empower, and succeed. These values include caring, excellence, respect, accessibility, innovation, and integrity. The center is committed to providing its clients with quality care while upholding their dignity.

Community integration plays a crucial role in the recovery process. Muskoka Recovery acknowledges this and helps its clients in various ways, including resume preparation, finding housing and connecting them with potential employers. The center helps clients get back on track, maintain or rebuild connections with their community for a smoother transition.

The rehabilitation facility boasts beautiful surroundings with luxurious accommodations. Its treatment programming is effective and tailored to accommodate individual needs. The center offers gourmet and nutritious food to support clients’ health and wellbeing. The staff here is friendly, competent, and dedicated to offering patients the best care possible. The center maintains the highest level of confidentiality to ensure client privacy.

The rehabilitation provides clients with a smooth transition post-treatment and supportive aftercare. It offers flexibility when it comes to work, so clients can balance their professional and recovery goals. The center provides transparent and straightforward costs and expectations, ensuring that clients understand what is required of them.

Apart from addressing addiction, the centre addresses trauma to pave the way for full recovery. The center recognizes the importance of healthy and fun activities in the recovery process and provides clients access to nature. Clients at Muskoka Recovery are treated with respect, ensuring that their recovery journey is a positive and empowering experience.

raw_html:
At Muskoka Recovery program, our aim is to offer a holistic approach to supporting clients through addiction recovery, relapse prevention, and optimal mental health. Our approach is centered around the needs of each individual client, with a range of individual counseling and group therapy services on offer. Our group therapy is designed to provide support through psychoeducation, skills and interventions, and a sense of communal belonging and fellowship. We also offer mental health support services utilizing a variety of therapeutic techniques that are tailored to meet the unique needs of each client.

Muskoka Recovery - Center Overview

Muskoka Recovery is a rehabilitation center located in the serene forested suburbs outside Toronto. It provides a range of services that includes detoxification, as well as residential care in two locations- King City and Muskoka. The center offers personalized and holistic care for mental health treatment, relapse prevention plans, and therapeutic sessions.

The centre has a set of core values that its team embodies to help clients recover, empower, and succeed. These values include caring, excellence, respect, accessibility, innovation, and integrity. The center is committed to providing its clients with quality care while upholding their dignity.

Community integration plays a crucial role in the recovery process. Muskoka Recovery acknowledges this and helps its clients in various ways, including resume preparation, finding housing and connecting them with potential employers. The center helps clients get back on track, maintain or rebuild connections with their community for a smoother transition.

The rehabilitation facility boasts beautiful surroundings with luxurious accommodations. Its treatment programming is effective and tailored to accommodate individual needs. The center offers gourmet and nutritious food to support clients’ health and wellbeing. The staff here is friendly, competent, and dedicated to offering patients the best care possible. The center maintains the highest level of confidentiality to ensure client privacy.

The rehabilitation provides clients with a smooth transition post-treatment and supportive aftercare. It offers flexibility when it comes to work, so clients can balance their professional and recovery goals. The center provides transparent and straightforward costs and expectations, ensuring that clients understand what is required of them.

Apart from addressing addiction, the centre addresses trauma to pave the way for full recovery. The center recognizes the importance of healthy and fun activities in the recovery process and provides clients access to nature. Clients at Muskoka Recovery are treated with respect, ensuring that their recovery journey is a positive and empowering experience.
